label: Council tax
official_term: Council Tax (net of Council Tax Reduction)
desc: What residents pay through the council's part of the bill, after Council Tax Reduction

label: General Revenue Grant
desc: The council's main general grant from the Scottish Government

label: Business rates (Scotland's shared pot)
desc: Business rates are pooled across Scotland and shared out by the Scottish Government, so this is not what local businesses pay

label: Other income
official_term: Other taxation and non-specific grant income
desc: Discretionary housing payment funding, tax increment financing, visitor levy and other income

label: Capital money used for day-to-day costs
official_term: Use of capital resources to fund revenue costs as permitted by statute
desc: One-off: money for building work used for day-to-day costs this year

label: Drawn from the capital fund
desc: One-off: money set aside for building work used for day-to-day costs this year

label: Drawn from council reserves
official_term: General Fund balance, other reserves and transfers to council housing
desc: One-off: once spent, the gap returns the year after
